maya_prod: Drafting the internal release blurb for tonight's deploy (v2.4.1). Need a quick pass on exec summary, pinning policy, and exact rollback triggers. Window: 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC (60m).

maya_prod: Proposed blurb below 12 — please respond with +1 or quick edit. cc @luca_oncall @sam_sre for rollback ops.
```
Internal release: v2.4.1 (runtime + batching)
- TL;DR: Optimizes runtime batching and KV caching to lower per-token cost and improve median throughput for short prompts. No user-facing intented changes.
- When: 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC (1h change window).
- Artifact: model-serving:v2.4.1 (immutable). Routing fallback pinned to model-serving:v2.4.0.
- Canary rollout: create routing lane v2.4.1-canary -> 5% for 10m -> 20% for 15m -> 100% if all checks pass.
- Key metrics to watch: runtime.latency.p95, runtime.errors.rate, runtime.kv.cache_miss, infra.gpu_util.
- Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 250ms for 10m, error rate > 2% for 5m, or KV cache miss spike > 3x baseline lasting 10m. Any SEV opened by Support = immediate pause and investigation.
- Owner: maya_prod. Oncall: luca_oncall. QA: qa-bot (smoke).
```

ethan_eng: change: make second canary step 30% (not 20%). Load tests showed better stability at 30% before full push. Also add a note to pin quantized variant if fallback used.

maya_prod: updated to 30% + added fallback quantized pin.

joanna_docs: copy edit: replace "No user-facing intented changes" -> "No user-facing changes expected". Add one-liner for Support: "If customers report regressions, attach request id and ping #eng-oncall."
